description: This file contains PyTorch microbenchmarking code, including a base class for benchmarking operators, a test case class for running benchmarks with JIT and compile modes, and a factory function for creating test cases. It also imports external C++ extension and PyTorch libraries.

classes.name: TorchBenchmarkBase
classes.description: Base class for creating PyTorch operator benchmarks, providing methods for input handling, memory traffic estimation, and module naming.

classes.name: PyTorchOperatorTestCase
classes.description: Class encapsulating all information needed to benchmark a PyTorch operator, including methods for running forward and backward passes with different execution modes.

methods.name: create_pytorch_op_test_case
methods.description: Factory function to generate a unique test case name and instantiate a PyTorchOperatorTestCase.
